title: Platforms I've designed & shipped.
subtitle: The systems behind the numbers — from AI-driven operations at Sprinklr to payments migrations at Paytm.

items.name: Cosmic — AIOps Platform & MCP Gateway
items.summary: Sprinklr's internal AIOps platform. One MCP gateway puts 21+ DevOps tools and 100+ clusters behind RBAC, and powers workflows, a Kubernetes lens and AI agents on top.
impact: 21+ DevOps tools behind one MCP gateway
AI agents that work for you
highlights: MCP gateway — one RBAC-governed endpoint for AWS, Kubernetes, Prometheus, PagerDuty, Jenkins, Graylog, Elasticsearch and more; works with public MCP clients like Claude and Cursor.
Workflows — build as many as you need, chaining any DevOps tool through its MCP, with approvals, schedules and version history.
Kubernetes lens — multi-cluster visibility and troubleshooting across 100+ clusters.
Agents — Cosmic can work for you as an agent: triage incidents, run health checks and execute workflows on request.

items.name: Prism · Chronos · Astrosync
items.summary: The platforms inside the Cosmic ecosystem for Kubernetes, alerting and patching across 100+ clusters.
highlights: Prism — multi-cluster Kubernetes visibility and troubleshooting.
Astrosync — scheduled OS/package patching with safe rollback.

items.name: High-throughput Telemetry Pipeline
items.summary: OpenTelemetry + Kafka pipeline storing logs and traces in ClickHouse and metrics in VictoriaMetrics — horizontally scalable and fault-tolerant.
highlights: Self-hosted ClickHouse on Kubernetes tuned for fast log & trace queries.
High-cardinality, long-term metrics at lower cost.

items.name: Progressive Delivery & Chaos
items.summary: Canary and blue-green releases with Argo Rollouts, plus chaos experiments in CI/CD to prove resilience before release.
highlights: Node failures, pod evictions and network faults tested pre-release.

items.name: PG2 Migration — Ali Cloud to AWS
items.summary: Moved Paytm's PG2 payment microservices from Ali Cloud to AWS on EKS with full CI/CD and monitoring.
highlights: Won Paytm Rockstar Awards in 2022 and 2024.

items.name: Scheduled HPA Operator
items.summary: Kubernetes Operator built on Custom Resource Definitions that patches Horizontal Pod Autoscalers on a schedule.

items.name: DevOps Custom UI
items.summary: Role-based DevOps portal for compliance, vendor VPN, AWS monitoring (EC2, RDS, ELB) and infrastructure approvals.
highlights: Paired with 2FA + role-based vendor firewall access.

items.name: Business Metrics Dashboard
items.summary: Grafana + Prometheus dashboard for business-critical metrics with automated alerting.
highlights: Business KPIs side by side with infrastructure health.
